summary: Near-complete bilateral lung opacification on the prior image has substantially cleared on the current image, most markedly on the right.

findings.rationale: Prior study shows diffuse dense bilateral haze with near-total silhouetting of vascular markings and the diaphragm; current study, matched by rib and hilar landmarks, shows the right lung largely re-aerated with visible vessels and ribs, and the left lung also less hazy than before. The magnitude of change is far greater than expected from exposure or technique differences.
